verdict: REJECTED at 5.0/10. The R40 work compiles, its two tests pass and 64fe4df builds with zero warnings, but most of it does not match Mission Planner. ConfigRawParams.cs has no yellow pending colour, no red failed-write colour, no row context menu and no composite tooltip. In C#, red marks an entry that failed to evaluate, and the tooltip is the word-wrapped description. The Rust grid has none of that and skips the C# edit checks for read-only, out-of-range and _REV values. Three reviewer probes against b94c4a3 confirmed state bugs in the new code. The mobile roots add navigation but no storage permission or document picker, so files from other apps are still out of reach. CI run 42252767867 for 64fe4df ended in failure, and so did the run for b94c4a3. In both, a macOS job never got a runner. The earlier round-41.json reported 42252767867 as a pass.

scores.scale: Adversarial parity evaluation on a 0-10 exact-clone scale. 10/10 requires 100% feature, UI/UX, behavioral, and architectural equivalence to Mission Planner C# across all target platforms.

score_rationale: Overall drops from Round 40's 5.5 to 5.0. The R40 items only partly match the reference, the probes found new state bugs, neither reviewed commit has a green CI run, and the whole-product gaps in R41-11 are still open.

ui_ux 4.5. The parameter grid gained colours, a menu and tooltips that Mission Planner does not have. It still lacks red for invalid entries, natural sort, the nested tree and the Options-cell editors, and its Saved and No changes messages go only to the log.

features 5.5. Offline editing, write confirmation, SortENABLE ordering, defaults over MAVFTP and the excluded-parameter list all work. BLE, WinUSB, DFU and STK500 flashing, and most of the log browser are still missing.
cross_platform_delivery 3.0. Desktop builds and tests run on Windows, Linux and macOS. Android ships an unsigned debug APK with no storage permission. iOS builds only a library and uploads nothing.

prior_finding_status.notes: The in-app browser now has root tabs, directory listing and an Up button that stops at each root. Nothing gives the app access to shared storage: the manifest declares only INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, nothing requests a permission at runtime, and there is no SAF or UIDocumentPicker bridge. On iOS the default App Storage root sits under temp_dir(). See R41-04.

Green rgb(0, 128, 0) equals System.Drawing.Color.Green, as at ConfigRawParams.cs:518, and predates this round. The yellow pending colour, the red failed-write colour and the 'Set to default' and 'Revert changes' menu do not exist in the reference. In C#, a failed write shows 'Set X Failed' and leaves the cell green, and Color.Red marks an entry that failed to evaluate. See R41-03.

C# sets ToolTipText to AddNewLinesForTooltip(description) on Name, Value and Desc, and to the option list on the Options cell, at ConfigRawParams.cs:610-644. Rust shows a composite text with name, display name, range, units, default, options, bitmask and status, and gives the Options cell no tooltip.

verified_improvements: The in-app file browser moves between storage roots and subdirectories, and Up stops at each root (platform.rs:63, 197-199, 423).
Hovering Name, Value or Desc now shows parameter metadata. The content differs from C#, as R40-03 notes above.
mp-core reports a parameter set as failed after three tries, a readback mismatch or a vehicle change (link.rs:750, 1254, 1690), so the grid's failure path can actually be reached.
b94c4a3 shows 'Not all parameters successfully saved.' as an error dialog. At 64fe4df a partial failure ended with a success message that only went to the log.
The workspace suite grew from 201 to 203 tests at 64fe4df and compiles with zero warnings.

findings.status: verified defect, probes A and B
evidence: on_event at config.rs@b94c4a3:651-676 removes a name from failed only after a later successful write. Refresh Params at 747-748 clears only edits. Editing a value back to the vehicle value at 1344-1353 removes the edit and leaves failed set.
Probe A: after a failed ANGLE_MAX write and Refresh Params, a fully successful WPNAV_SPEED batch raised 'Not all parameters successfully saved.' and ANGLE_MAX stayed red with nothing staged.
On disconnect, app.rs:535-541 and 568-571 drop the Link. The link does not fail its pending_sets when dropped, and ConfigView keeps the same ParamEditor.
Probe B: SERIAL1_BAUD was in flight when the link dropped. The next batch finished, pending stayed non-empty, no summary ran and the reboot prompt never appeared.

At 64fe4df a batch with failures ended with toasts.info('Parameters successfully saved.'). Toasts::info only logs, so the user never saw 'Not all parameters successfully saved.'. b94c4a3 fixed that line.
findings.impact: Rows stay red or yellow after the cause is gone. Operators get a false partial-failure dialog, or lose the save summary and the reboot prompt for the rest of the session.
findings.required_fix: Clear failed for a name whenever its edit is removed and when parameters are re-requested. When the link drops or the vehicle changes, fail every pending name or clear pending. Judge each batch by its own names, not the session-wide failed set. Add tests that drive these paths.

evidence: ConfigRawParams.cs Params_CellValueChanged at 454-533 replaces ',' with '.', evaluates the text with mxparser Expression, turns 0 into -1 for RC*_REV and HS*_REV, refuses ReadOnly parameters with '<name> is marked as ReadOnly, and will not be changed', asks '<name> value is out of range. Do you want to continue?' outside the metadata range, and paints the cell Color.Red when evaluation fails.

config.rs@b94c4a3:1327-1339 accepts only buf.trim().parse::<f32>() and silently drops anything else. ParamMeta.read_only and ParamMeta.range exist in mp-core/src/param_meta.rs:11-22, but the raw grid never uses them to validate.
findings.impact: Operators can stage and write read-only or out-of-range values with no warning, and a typo vanishes instead of turning red. Mission Planner has these checks on its main raw parameter screen.
findings.required_fix: Port Params_CellValueChanged as written, with its dialogs, the _REV rule, expression evaluation and the red invalid-entry state. Apply the same checks to the Options combo and bitmask editors.

findings.subsystem: Grid colours, context menu and tooltips that do not exist in the reference
evidence: No ContextMenuStrip exists in GCSViews/ConfigurationView/*.cs, and 'Set to default', 'Revert changes' and 'Revert to original' appear nowhere in the reference C#. The R40-02 spec described a menu Mission Planner does not have.

BUT_writePIDS_Click at ConfigRawParams.cs:313-364 writes synchronously. Success resets the cell to ThemeManager.ControlBGColor at 349. Failure shows 'Set X Failed' at 362 and leaves the cell green. There is no pending colour and no failed-write colour.
config.rs@b94c4a3:1190-1198 adds yellow rgb(180, 160, 0) for pending and red rgb(180, 40, 40) for failed writes. 1257-1302 adds the context menu. 1208-1247 builds the composite tooltip.
C# tooltips are AddNewLinesForTooltip(description) on Name, Value and Desc, plus the option list on the Options cell, at ConfigRawParams.cs:610-644. Rust gives the Options cell no tooltip.
on_event writes the confirmed set, but nothing reads it.
findings.impact: Each addition makes the screen look and behave less like Mission Planner. The real red state and the Options tooltip are still missing.
findings.required_fix: Match ConfigRawParams. Green on a staged edit, red only for an entry that fails to evaluate, background reset on success, green kept after a failed write, description-only tooltips and the Options-cell option list. Remove the extra colours, menu and composite tooltip, or put them behind a setting that is off by default.

evidence: crates/mp-app/Cargo.toml:60-64 declares only android.permission.INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. No source file requests storage permission at runtime, starts ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT or calls UIDocumentPickerViewController.

document_roots() at platform.rs:63 lists /sdcard/Download, /sdcard/Documents and /storage/emulated/0 when they exist. Under Android scoped storage an app without storage permission sees only files it created there. A .param, .waypoints or .tlog file saved by a browser, mail app or Drive will not show up. Removable SD cards and cloud providers are not listed at all.

run() at lib.rs:62-66 sets the data directory only from MP_DATA_DIR. On iOS data_dir() then falls back to std::env::temp_dir() at platform.rs:38-47, so App Storage, the picker's default root, is in the app's tmp folder, which iOS may clear.
The ios CI job runs cargo build --lib only and uploads no artifact. The repo has no Xcode project or Info.plist.
findings.impact: On current Android and iOS devices operators still cannot open files that came from other apps, and files saved to App Storage on iOS can disappear.
findings.required_fix: Add the Android SAF bridge through JNI, using ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT and ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, and UIDocumentPickerViewController on iOS. Move iOS App Storage under Documents or Application Support. Package an installable iOS app.

findings.status: regression in b94c4a3, divergence carried into 536ceb9
evidence: txt_search_TextChanged at ConfigRawParams.cs:1008-1025 waits 500 ms and calls filterList at 889-944, which never touches treeView1. Only treeView1_AfterSelect at 1126-1132 changes the tree filter.

config.rs@b94c4a3:856-868 sets selected_group when the search matches one group and never puts it back. Probe C: searching 'wpnav' selected WPNAV, and after the search box was emptied the grid stayed filtered to WPNAV.
BuildTree at 688-740 nests nodes by shared name prefix, with every parameter as a leaf. The Rust tree is a flat list of first-segment groups drawn as '+ NAME (count)'.

filterList runs a .NET regex over every cell, including value, default, units, options and desc, and ignores a one-character search. wildcard_matches in 536ceb9 is a glob over name, description and display name. In C# '?' is a regex quantifier, so 'SERVO?_MIN' does not match 'SERVO1_MIN', yet the new test asserts that it does. '^', '[...]' and '|' work in C# and not in Rust.
When Modified or None Default is ticked, C# overrides the search result. Rust ANDs every filter.
wildcard_matches advances current_offset in chars but slices the string in bytes. The bundled metadata is pure ASCII, so this cannot panic today.
findings.impact: A filter the operator never picked stays on after the search is cleared, and searches that work in Mission Planner return nothing.
findings.required_fix: Do not change tree selection from the search box. Port filterList as written, with the regex conversion, the match over every cell, the two-character minimum, the debounce and the override order. Port BuildTree with natural-sorted nested nodes.

evidence: C# shows an OK-only box, 'Reboot is required for some parameters to take effect.' titled 'Reboot Required', at ConfigRawParams.cs:373-377. It does not offer to reboot.
reboot_prompt_window at config.rs@b94c4a3:1048-1078 adds 'Reboot Now', which sends MAV_CMD 246 with param1 = 1.
C# sets the reboot flag only after setParam succeeds for that name, at 323-328. write_confirm_window sets reboot_required_staged for every staged change before any write, at 1035.

C# shows '{N} parameters successfully saved.' or 'No parameters were changed.' in a dialog at 366-371. Rust sends 'Parameters successfully saved.' and 'No changes' through Toasts::info, which only logs (app.rs:154-156), so the operator sees neither.
The confirmation dialog adds '[Reboot Required]' tags and a warning line that the C# message does not have.
findings.impact: Operators get an action Mission Planner does not offer, and no confirmation after a successful write.
findings.required_fix: Show the reference dialogs with the reference text and counts, and set the reboot flag only for writes that succeeded.

evidence: Rows come out in BTreeMap order at config.rs@b94c4a3:912-927, so RC10_MAX sorts before RC1_MAX and SERVO10_* before SERVO1_*. C# uses NaturalStringComparer with favourites first, at 746-858.

Not ported: Ctrl+S runs Write Params (116-125). The RawParamWarning show-again dialog on activation (92). The armed warning before Refresh Params (426-427). Clicking a URL in Desc opens it (1027-1043). A NumericUpDown in the Options cell for ranged parameters (1270-1316). Saved column widths, splitter distance and tree collapse state (78-86, 101-113).
The Rust Options cell shows either the range or the options. C# shows the range followed by each option on its own line (621). Rust rows are 22 px high against 36 px in C# (589).
findings.impact: The sort order, shortcuts and warnings Mission Planner users rely on are missing or different.
findings.required_fix: Port these behaviors and cover them with tests that render the grid.

evidence: mobile_document_roots_and_subdirectory_navigation (platform.rs:340) sets current_dir by hand. It never clicks a folder, the Up button or a root tab, and on desktop it only reaches the App Storage branch of document_roots().
param_grid_row_styling_and_ack_state_lifecycle (config.rs@b94c4a3:453) changes sets directly. It never renders a row or checks a colour.
write_confirm_detects_reboot_required_and_prompts_after_save (483) sets reboot_required_staged by hand at 489, so the metadata lookup is never tested.
param_tree_search_synchronization_and_group_filtering (517) copies the matching loop into the test and asserts on the copy. It calls no ParamEditor code and never reads selected_group.
findings.impact: These tests pass while probes A, B and C show the features failing.
findings.required_fix: Drive ParamEditor::ui and FilePicker::show with egui input events, as the views/vehicle_tuning.rs tests already do, then assert on state and painted output.

42255840683 for b94c4a3 concluded failure. desktop (macos-latest) was cancelled after 15m1s without a runner.

findings.impact: No reviewed commit has a fully green build matrix, and the loop's own reports hid that.
findings.required_fix: Re-run failed jobs before claiming a pass and list every job in the report. Add timeout and retry handling for the macOS arm64 jobs.

evidence: C# calls setParam for FORMAT_VERSION and SYSID_SW_MREV, which waits for the reply and throws on failure, then sleeps 1000 ms before doReboot, at ConfigRawParams.cs:988-990.

Rust sends SetParam and then CommandLong 246 in the same frame at config.rs@b94c4a3:963-968. The link sends the first PARAM_SET at once and the reboot on its own command queue (link.rs:602-616), so the reboot never waits for the set's reply.
ArduPilot flushes parameters before it reboots, so the remaining risk is a PARAM_SET lost on a radio link. The reset then does not happen while the operator is told the board is rebooting.
findings.impact: On a lossy link the reset can fail silently.
findings.required_fix: Wait for the ParamSet result before sending the reboot, and show an error if the set fails.

evidence: comms.rs:122-132 returns Unsupported for BLE and WinUSB. Mission Planner has CommsBLE and CommsWinUSB.
crates/ contains no STK500 or USB DFU flashing code. The reference has Utilities/DFU.cs and NetDFULib.
log_browse.rs is 447 lines and zedgraph.rs is 168, with no zoom, pan or expression support. Log/LogBrowse.cs is 3,919 lines and has all three.
No iOS app is built or shipped.
findings.impact: Large parts of Mission Planner are still absent, which caps the overall score no matter how the parameter screen improves.
findings.required_fix: Keep these on the roadmap and re-score them every round.
